facts.fact: UNDP reports that in the East Region two centres had passed into production by August 2026, Bertoua 1er (about 10 acts a day) and the Bertoua City Council (10 to 15 acts), while Bertoua II, Batouri, Abong-Mbang, Betare-Oya and Garoua-Boulai were still being equipped and trained; it gives no regional or national total of centres.
facts.system: Système Intégré de Gestion de l'État Civil (SIGEC)

facts.fact: UNDP describes each commune receiving its own server, workstations and network with SIGEC installed on them; at Bertoua 1er backups run automatically on the commune's server with a copy on an external hard disk, and disaggregated statistics can be produced and transmitted to BUNEC.
facts.system: Système Intégré de Gestion de l'État Civil (SIGEC)

facts.fact: UNDP says the East Region's civil status centres are changing how birth, marriage and death acts are recorded, kept and issued; agents at Bertoua II were trained on recording and producing birth and marriage acts in SIGEC, and the region's first digitalised birth act was produced a few weeks before August 2026.
facts.system: Système Intégré de Gestion de l'État Civil (SIGEC)

facts.fact: The East Region's first digitalised birth act was produced a few weeks before August 2026 and the first communes there (Bertoua, Bertoua II, Abong-Mbang, Batouri, Betare-Oya, Garoua-Boulai) are moving from the manual system to SIGEC, per UNDP.
facts.system: Système Intégré de Gestion de l'État Civil (SIGEC)

facts.fact: UNDP says the East Region deployment is carried by its Legal Identity II project, in partnership with BUNEC, as support to the modernisation of the national civil status system; BUNEC trainers work in the communes.
facts.system: Système Intégré de Gestion de l'État Civil (SIGEC)

facts.fact: The deployment of servers, workstations, networks, SIGEC and training in the East Region communes is carried by UNDP's Legal Identity II project, per UNDP; the document names no national budget line.
facts.system: Système Intégré de Gestion de l'État Civil (SIGEC)

facts.fact: UNDP reports that the commune of Bertoua 1er already has a budget line for maintenance and the internet connection, and that the Bertoua City Council has raised its civil status service to a sub-directorate that is to have a budget for equipment maintenance and staff training.
facts.system: Système Intégré de Gestion de l'État Civil (SIGEC)
